newsitem.title: GERMANY: HOCKEY-AUSTRALIA AND DUTCH BOTH WIN 3-0.
newsitem.headline: HOCKEY-AUSTRALIA AND DUTCH BOTH WIN 3-0.

text.p: Olympic champions Australia and the Netherlands, bronze medal winners in Atlanta, won their third round matches at the women's Champions' Trophy tournament on Wednesday.
Australia maintained their unbeaten record with a 3-0 victory over Britain, while the Netherlands handed the United States their first defeat, winnning 3-0.
The Netherlands' victory against the Americans, joint leaders with Australia after two matches, enabled them to move into second place, a point behind the Olympic and World Cup champions.
Germany moved into third place with a 3-2 win against South Korea.
